verses.text: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus by God will, according to di promise of di life wey dey inside Christ Jesus,
to Timothy, my dear pikin: Grace, mercy and peace from Papa God and Christ Jesus our Lord.
I thank God, wey I dey serve with clean conscience like my forefathers, as I dey remember you without stop for my prayer dem, night and day,
as I dey long to see you, and I dey remember your tears, so that joy go full me;
as I dey remember di true faith wey dey inside you, wey first dey inside your grandmama Lois and your mama Eunice, and I sure say e dey inside you too.
Na why I dey remind you make you wake up di gift of God wey dey inside you through di laying of my hands on you.
Because God no give us spirit of fear, but of power, love and self-control.
So no shame for di testimony of our Lord, or for me wey be im prisoner, but join suffer for di Good News with di power of God,
wey save us and call us with holy calling, no be because of our works, but according to im own purpose and grace, wey dem give us inside Christ Jesus before di times wey no dey end,
but now e don show through di appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, wey finish death power and bring life and immortality to light through di Good News,
wey dem appoint me preacher, apostle and teacher of di Gentiles for.
Na for dis reason I dey suffer dese things too. But I no shame, because I know di one wey I believe, and I sure say e fit guard wetin I commit to am until dat day.
Hold di pattern of sound words wey you hear from me, with faith and love wey dey inside Christ Jesus.
Guard dat good thing wey dem commit to you, through Holy Spirit wey dey stay inside us.
You know say all dem wey dey Asia don turn comot from me; among dem na Phygelus and Hermogenes.
Make Lord show mercy to Onesiphorus house, because e dey often refresh me, and e no shame for my chain,
but when e dey Rome, e look for me well well and find me.
Make Lord give am make e find Lord mercy for dat day. And you know very well how many things e do to serve for Ephesus.
So you, my pikin, make you strong inside di grace wey dey inside Christ Jesus.
Di things wey you hear from me before plenty witnesses, commit dem to faithful men wey go fit teach other people too.
So you must endure hardship, like good soldier of Christ Jesus.
No soldier wey dey on duty dey tangle imself for di matter dem of dis life, so that e go please di one wey recruit am as soldier.
Again, if anybody dey compete for sport, dem no go crown am unless e compete according to di rules.
Di farmer wey dey labor must be di first to get share of di crop.
Think about wetin I talk, and make Lord give you understanding for everything.
Remember Jesus Christ, wey rise from di dead, wey come from David seed, according to my Good News,
na for dis Good News I dey suffer hardship reach chain, like criminal. But dem no fit chain God word.
So I dey endure everything for di sake of God chosen people, so that dem too go receive di salvation wey dey inside Christ Jesus with glory wey no dey end.
Dis saying dey true: if we die with am, we go live with am too.
If we endure, we go rule with am too. If we deny am, e go deny us too.
If we no dey faithful, e dey remain faithful. E no fit deny imself.
Remind dem dese things, and charge dem before Lord make dem no argue about words, wey no get profit and dey spoil dem wey dey hear.
Try well well make you stand before God as person wey e approve, workman wey no need shame, wey dey handle di word of truth well.
But stay far from empty talk, because dem go go further for way wey no dey fear God,
and dem word go dey eat like gangrene. Among dem na Hymenaeus and Philetus,
men wey don miss di truth, as dem dey talk say di resurrection don pass already, and dem dey spoil di faith of some people.
But di strong foundation of God dey stand, as e get dis seal: “Di Lord know dem wey be im own,” and, “Make everybody wey call di name of di Lord comot from wickedness.”
Now for big house, no be only container dem of gold and silver dey, but of wood and clay too. Some na for honor, and some na for dishonor.
So if anybody clean imself from dese things, e go be container for honor, wey dem don make holy, wey fit di oga use, ready for every good work.
Run comot from young people desire dem, and follow righteousness, faith, love and peace with dem wey dey call Lord from clean heart.
But refuse foolish and ignorant argument, because you know say dem dey cause quarrel.
Lord servant must no quarrel, but must dey gentle to everybody, fit teach, and dey patient,
as e dey correct dem wey dey oppose am with gentleness: maybe God go give dem repentance wey go lead dem come know di truth well,
and dem go wake up comot from di trap of di devil, wey don catch dem to do im will.
But know dis one, say for di last days hard times go come.
Because men go love imself, love money, boast, get pride, blaspheme, no obey dem papa and mama, no dey thankful, no be holy,
no get natural love, no dey forgive, dey slander, no get self-control, dey fierce, no love wetin good,
dey betray people, dey stubborn, dey puff up with pride, love pleasure pass how dem love God;
as dem dey look like person wey dey fear God, but dem don deny im power. Comot from such people too.
Because among dem some dey enter people house quietly and dey catch women wey sin load heavy, wey different desire dey lead go,
dem dey always learn, but dem never fit come know di truth.
Just as Jannes and Jambres oppose Moses, na so dese ones dey oppose di truth too: men wey get spoil mind, wey dem reject for di faith.
But dem no go go further. Because everybody go see dem foolishness, just as Jannes and Jambres own come clear.
But you don follow my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love and endurance,
my persecutions and sufferings: di things wey happen to me for Antioch, for Iconium and for Lystra. I endure dose persecution dem, and Lord save me from all of dem.
Yes, and all dem wey want live for fear of God inside Christ Jesus go suffer persecution.
But evil men and impostors go dey worse and worse, as dem dey deceive people and dem too dey deceive.
But you, continue for di things wey you learn and wey you sure of, as you know who teach you dem.
From when you small, you don know di holy writing dem wey fit make you wise for salvation through faith wey dey inside Christ Jesus.
Every Scripture na God breathe am out and e dey useful for teaching, for rebuke, for correction and for training for righteousness,
so that di man of God go complete, and ready well for every good work.
I charge you before God and Christ Jesus, wey go judge di living and di dead, and by im appearing and im Kingdom:
Preach di word; dey ready when e good and when e no good; reprove, rebuke and encourage, with all patience and teaching.
But di time go come when dem no go gree listen to di sound doctrine, but dem go gather teachers for demself wey go suit dem own desire, as dem ear dey itch dem,
and dem go turn dem ear comot from di truth and turn go story dem wey no be true.
But you, keep clear mind for everything, endure hardship, do di work of person wey dey preach Good News, and finish your work.
Because dem don dey pour me out like sacrifice already, and di time of my going don reach.
I don fight di good fight. I don finish di race. I don keep di faith.
From now, dem don keep di crown of righteousness for me, wey Lord, di righteous judge, go give me for dat day; and no be to me only, but to all dem wey love im appearing too.
Try come meet me soon,
because Demas don leave me, as e love dis present world, and e go Thessalonica; Crescens go Galatia; Titus go Dalmatia.
Only Luke dey with me. Carry Mark come with you, because e dey useful to me for service.
But I don send Tychicus go Ephesus.
When you dey come, bring di cloak wey I leave for Troas with Carpus, and di books, especially di parchments.
Alexander di coppersmith do me plenty evil. Lord go pay am according to im deeds,
and make you take care of am too, because e strongly oppose our words.
For my first defense, nobody stand with me, but all of dem leave me. Make dem no hold am against dem.
But Lord stand by me and give me strength, so that through me di message go full preach, and all di Gentiles go hear am; and I escape from di mouth of di lion.
Lord go save me from every evil work, and e go keep me reach im Kingdom for heaven; make glory dey for am forever and ever. Amen.
Greet Prisca and Aquila, and Onesiphorus house.
Erastus stay for Corinth, but I leave Trophimus for Miletus as e dey sick.
Try come before winter. Eubulus dey greet you, and Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all di brothers dey greet you too.
Make Lord dey with your spirit. Grace dey with you. Amen.
